items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I played with Papa Celestine. Yeah. I never was a regular member.

ctx.x: How many pieces did he have with him? Well, he had about seven pieces.

I never just stayed with him long, but it's, it was a kick to play with him old-timers like him. I played with Papa Celestine. Yeah. I never was a regular member. Yeah. But I played, you know, like they needed, I guess couldn't get through by now, so I played with those. Yeah. Which, uh, but I tell you people, like I said, that never hit Boydman Street, I played with, like, boys like Eulah Jones. Yeah. Uh, well, she's on Boydman Street now, but I remember during the time this boy, uh, playing drum with us there…
